resources.string: Browse, import, and share on-screen controls
Discover controls made by the community. Packs include button artwork, layout, and actions. Review a pack before applying it to a profile.
No controls match this screen and search.
Export your controls and share the ZIP directly, or submit it through the selected source’s website. Each source manages its own uploads and catalog. GitHub sources require a GitHub account.
Pack exported. You can share the ZIP directly or attach it to a community submission.

Enter a public GitHub repository or an HTTPS catalog.json or manifest.json URL. Supports DroidDeck controls packs and ARMSX2 controller skins. Downloads come directly from the source.
